study_identification_part.si4_title: Individualized cortical thickness asymmetry in Autism Spectrum Disorders and Schizophrenia

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Apply normative modeling to quantify individual-level deviations in cortical thickness asymmetry (AI) in ASD and SZ, and assess whether deviations are over-represented regionally or at whole-brain level compared to healthy controls.

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: The paper details the primary pipeline and variations for sensitivity analyses, explicitly naming the software and tools used.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Thereafter all remaining images were processed centrally using the FreeSurfer analysis suite (v7.1) with default settings... we applied the Computational Anatomy Toolbox to generate a weighted overall image quality rating (IQR)... We applied a validated symmetric parcellation of 160 regions... we processed all images using a validated higher resolution parcellation (1000 regions)... We generated unsmoothed vertex-wise standard space cortical thickness maps for each participant and hemisphere from Freesurfer using Freesurfer's 'qcache' command. These maps were inserted into Freesurfer's 'xhemi'...

rci8_quality_checking.answer: Initial filtering of low-quality ABIDE data based on Bedford et al. (2023)
rci8_quality_checking.detail: Initial filtering of low-quality ABIDE data based on Bedford et al. (2023). Exclusion of 682 images with IQR > 2.8. Exclusion of 5 images with within-dataset centered Euler number > 10. Euler number was also included as a covariate in the normative model.
rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: The ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II datasets include low quality T1 data... We initially included only images from ABIDE that we denoted as the highest quality... As per previous work, we excluded 682 images with an IQR >2.8... Finally, as per previous work, images were removed if the maximum, absolute, within-dataset centered Euler number was larger than 10... This was the case for five images.
rci8_quality_checking.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Methods / Image processing and quality control

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: Scanner was included as a covariate in the Bayesian Linear Regression normative model. Post-hoc validation was performed using one-versus-all linear support vector machines to classify scan sites from z-scores, with resulting balanced accuracy near chance level (50%) indicating minimal residual site effects.
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: ...established a normative range for AI, considering an individual's age, sex, Euler number, and scanner. ... We assessed data bias over sites using linear support vector classifiers... A mean balanced accuracy near chance level (50%) served as an indicator that the observed deviations were minimally influenced by residual site effects, which was confirmed for our main approach...
rci9_site_effect_handling.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Methods / Normative modeling; Methods / Statistical analyses

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: ASD cortical thickness asymmetry lies within normative variation at whole-brain and regional levels; SZ shows only a very small, isolated regional difference with minimal effect size; multivariate patterns do not differentiate diagnoses.
